description: This file defines a netlink handle for managing network namespace requests, including socket configuration, support checks, and resource management functions.

classes.name: Handle
classes.description: Represents a netlink handle for network namespace requests, managing sockets and support options.

methods.name: SetSocketTimeout
methods.description: Configures the timeout for default netlink sockets.

methods.name: GetSocketTimeout
methods.description: Returns the current timeout value used by netlink sockets.

methods.name: SupportsNetlinkFamily
methods.description: Checks if a specific netlink family is supported by this handle.

methods.name: NewHandle
methods.description: Creates a new netlink handle for the current network namespace supporting specified families.

methods.name: SetSocketTimeout
methods.description: Sets send and receive timeouts for all sockets in the handle.

methods.name: SetSocketReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the receive buffer size for all sockets in the handle.

methods.name: GetSocketReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Retrieves the receive buffer sizes for all sockets.

methods.name: SetStrictCheck
methods.description: Enables or disables strict check socket option for all sockets.

methods.name: NewHandleAt
methods.description: Creates a netlink handle on a specified network namespace.

methods.name: NewHandleAtFrom
methods.description: Creates a netlink handle on a new namespace based on an existing handle.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Releases resources allocated to the handle.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deprecated method to release resources, use Close instead.

methods.name: newNetlinkRequest
methods.description: Creates a new netlink request message.
